text:
maria: Heads up — AcmeCorp legal just signaled they need a clear upgrade path for our on‑prem distro that guarantees <24h downtime windows and an entitlement-based pricing option for VPC deployments. They want cost estimates and a short rollout playbook by EOD Friday.

aj: ack. can we scope the minimal viable path? do they need zero-downtime or just short maintenance windows?

maria: short windows only. they said they can schedule maintenance, but want conservative risk buckets and a fallback plan if the kernel/egress changes. also asking about per-tenant vs org-level pricing for private keys.

samir: from engineering perspective, the major risks are: kernel module changes for our private networking agent, db schema migrations for handshake metadata, and kube node drain behavior in older clusters.

elaine: product note — commercial asks: 1) entitlement SKUs (small/medium/large) tied to reserved capacity, 2) upgrade SLA (we can offer 48h for standard, 24h for premium), 3) optional on-site assistance. acme wants premium.

leo: for the upgrade playbook draft, propose:
```
1) preflight checks (agent version, iptables rules, kernel ver >= 5.10)
2) snapshot config and KV store
3) drain nodes in batches (max 10% concurrently)
4) apply package + handshake migration
5) smoke tests (connectivity, inference routing)
```

ben: adding cost tradeoffs: if they pick quantized model variants and shared caching, we can recommend medium SKU + burst credits which reduces infra cost 30%. If they insist on dedicated GPU pools per-tenant, cost doubles.

maria: can we get a rough RACI for customer communications and post-upgrade support? who owns on-call during the maintenance window?

ops_sre: ops owns preflight + emergency rollback. recommend SRE on-call + field-eng and a 6pm-11pm maintenance window LT. we need a 2hr rollback plan tested in staging.

aj: integration ask — we should offer a helper script that validates network egress and handshake ports (443, 8200). sample:
```
# run from customer bastion
curl -f https://ctl.redwood.example.com/health || echo "control plane unreachable"
nc -zv acme-private-ip 8200 || echo "handshake port blocked"
```

maria: perfect. also include a table of failure modes and recommended mitigations (eg. handshake key mismatch -> `rotate-keys` procedure).

samir: technical constraints to call out to customer: older RHEL 7 boxes may require manual sysctl tuning and have flaky `drain` behavior. we should mark RHEL7 as non-recommended but supported with field-eng.

elaine: launch criteria checklist draft:
- preflight script passes on >95% of customer fleet in canary
- rollback validated in staging within 2h
- documented cost SKUs + legal addendum for entitlements
- field-eng runbook and 24/7 escalation matrix

maria: can product & eng commit to the first draft by Thursday AM? I'll own the customer comms and pricing table.

aj: engineering will get a playbook + helper script by Thurs EOD. samir will run the staging rollback test.

samir: I'll schedule the rollback smoke with ops_sre for Wednesday.

deploy-bot: Deployment window draft created: 2026-03-25 18:00-22:00 UTC — ping @ops_sre @field-eng for confirmation. :calendar:

leo: i'll assemble the playbook doc and include a short sequence diagram for node drain -> handshake flush -> kv migration.

maria: thanks all. next steps: ship playbook, cost table, and preflight script. i'll loop in sales to get commercial feedback before we present to Acme. :thumbsup:
